title: Efficacy and safety of different inhaler types for asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. a systematic review and meta-analysis.

answer.design_quote: Where two or more studies within a group reported results for an outcome of interest, we performed meta-analysis using a random-effects model and inverse variance statistical methods using RevMan Web 24 .
answer.k_quote: A systematic review was performed finding 44 randomised trials (24,710 participants) and moderate certainty evidence for most outcomes.
